artifacts.title: A Basis for the 2-Kernel of Euler's Totient
artifacts.claim_scope: Standalone exposition of Erdős Problem 249, ordered unconditional results first: the exact level-e dyadic totient section rank 2^e+1 and the resulting infinite-dimensionality, the explicit denominator exclusion (whose Farey provenance is stated rather than implied), the phi*mu Lambert weight that separates #249 from the settled omega/Omega/tau series, and two scoped method no-go theorems. Every remaining obligation is named and the problem remains open.

artifacts.title: Forced Structure in Mersenne Subseries
artifacts.claim_scope: Standalone exposition of Erdős Problem 257 led by exact finite-period noncollapse, necessary structure for any rational-valued infinite support, and achievement-set geometry. Duverney–Tachiya's full-text Corollary 1.2 and Example 1.1 settle the squarefree support at base 2, but not at bases b≥3; the manuscript separately proves that two divisibility-first certificate engines miss this settled value and that irrationality is invariant under finite support changes via checked prefix/tail lemmas. Tao–Teräväinen prove the prime-support case at base 2; broader base and prime-power extensions are remarks rather than proved theorems there. Universal Erdős #257 and the half-value test remain open.

artifacts.title: The Centred State and the Surviving Negative Case
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos243 modules. Lean checks conditional integer-state implications excluding an eventually bounded negative part and, under normalised vanishing, finite normalised negative mass. The reciprocal-series/state bridge, strict centring, and normalised vanishing are not derived; the unbounded divergent-mass branch and Erdős Problem 243 remain open. These declarations are not reviewed public claims in docs/claims.json.

artifacts.title: The Prime-Gap Equivalence and the Integral-Shift Frontier
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos251 module. Lean checks the infinite prime/gap equivalence conditional on summability, denominator collapse for rational dyadic recurrences, unboundedness and non-eventual-periodicity of the actual prime gaps, the exact local implication from cofinally recurring adjacent small-mismatch tail shifts to failure of eventual integrality, and the generic distance-to-integers core of the finite-truncation criterion. The prime-number-theorem summability, concrete prime-gap-tail instantiation, tail domination, and block anti-concentration remain paper-level obligations; no theorem supplies the required cofinal adjacent small-mismatch pairs, and Erdős Problem 251 remains open.

artifacts.title: The Three-Prime Running Least Common Multiple
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos269 modules. Lean checks the exact dyadic block radix alphabet {2,6,10,30}, canonical least-positive-residue arithmetic, smooth-factor absorption, conditional common-factor cancellation, and the complete implication from denominator-dependent CofinalLocalWindowEscape to extinction of a bounded positive reduced carry. An integer-only checker supplies finite exact evidence for 106,666 denominator/start pairs, but the actual block-digit carry instantiation—including divisibility of the carry by the absorbed smooth denominator factor—and the cofinal escape producer are not proved; Erdős Problem 269 remains open.

artifacts.title: Rational Bases and the Integer-Base Argument
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos1049 modules. Lean checks the complete elementary Archimedean height inequality needed for the published Bundschuh–Väänänen special case q=7/2, while that analytic irrationality theorem remains external. Lean also checks that rowwise contents scale the Padé error, exterior determinant, and absolute determinant height by exactly the same factors; under unit endpoint hypotheses a common specialised multiplier contains neither two nor three. It checks the homogeneous endpoint obstruction, the negative scalar margin implication at three halves, the exact four-jet target cardinality, and the sufficient collision threshold n >= 4R+2S for positive R. The primary Zudilin theorem remains integer-base and external; a sufficiently large primitive non-collapsed family, surviving local gain after primitive normalisation, and a collision with nonzero polynomial pair and remainder are not proved. Erdős Problem 1049 remains open.
